patterns.name: Bullseye Constellation
patterns.summary: Bold target rings, arc fragments, and satellite dots. Reads like a geometric riso poster texture.

patterns.name: Scallop Wave
patterns.summary: Fish-scale arcs with a light dot rhythm. Softer and more textile-like.

patterns.name: Diagonal Hatch Orbit
patterns.summary: Angular hatch strokes broken by orbit rings. More aggressive and zine-like.

patterns.name: Mega Halftone Bloom
patterns.summary: Oversized halftone dots on a roomy lattice. Bold, airy, and easy to push through the downstream riso render.

patterns.name: Sunburst Offset Grid
patterns.summary: Half-drop scallop fans with satellite dots. Feels like print-era sunbursts without baking in any misregistration.

patterns.name: Brutalist Hatch Field
patterns.summary: Aggressive diagonal strokes, orbit rings, and square punctuation. Clean geometry built for downstream grain and ghosting.

patterns.name: Diamond Dot Matrix
patterns.summary: Diamond blocks with alternating dot weights. Closer to a geometric screen print grid than a generic web pattern.

patterns.name: Orbital Crossweave
patterns.summary: Crossed bars and orbit dots in a rigid matrix. Strong rhythm that stays clean under downstream grain.

patterns.name: Stepped Chevron Grid
patterns.summary: Chunky stair-step chevrons with seam-aware dot anchors. More poster-like than decorative.

patterns.name: Capsule Lattice
patterns.summary: Rounded capsule bars in a half-drop cadence. A softer geometric family that still reads as printed and modular.
